To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the investigated double perovskites are compatible with the investigated electrolytes, but their high TEC values and high oxygen permeation rates are not suitable for the fabrication of IT-SOFCs.
Sr 2 Ni0.75M0.25Mo 0.25 O 6 has high thermal and chemical compatibility and high proton conductivity with BaCe 0.80 Sm 0.20 O 2.80 and Ba 2 In0.67 W0.33 O5.25+δ.
Sr 2 NiMg 1/3 Mo 2/3 O 6  possesses a high electrical conductivity in the range of 0.01–1.00 × 10 3  S/cm, which is a prerequisite for the use of this material as an anode for IT-SOFC.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the evaluation of the Sr 2 NiMoO 6 -based material as an anode for IT-SOFCs.
the synthesis of Sr 2 NiMg 1 − x Mo x O 6 ( x  =  0.25 ) and its compatibility with different electrolytes.

the structural, chemical, and thermal compatibility between the molybdate-based anode material and various solid state electrolytes, which is an essential step towards the development of a high-performance IT-SOFC.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the investigated material is a potential anode for IT-SOFCs.
the Sr 2 NiMoO 6 -type double perovskites are promising anode materials for IT-SOFCs.

Sr 2 NiMoO 6 is a suitable anode material for solid oxide fuel cells with Zr 0.8 Y 0.2, Ce 0 8 Sm 0 2, La 0 88 Sr 0 12 Ga 0 82 Mg 0 18 and Ba 2 InW 0 33 as electrolytes, but not with BaCeSm and Ba 2 Ce 0 85 Sm 0 15 O 5
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the Sr 2 NiMoO 6 -based anode materials are promising candidates for IT-SOFCs, especially for the application of protonic electrolyte fuel cells.
Sr 2 Ni0.75Mn0.25Mo0 6  can be used as an anode material in IT-SOFCs with a solid electrolyte based on Ba 2 In1.67 W0.33O5+δ.
the Sr 2 NiMo 6 O 18  + δ ceramic material can be used as an IT-SOFC anode material, and it can be used in a wide range of temperatures.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the Sr 2 NiMoO 6 ceramic sample is thermally stable and compatible with the investigated oxygen-ionic (YSZ, GDC and LSAG) and protonic (BCS and BIZ) electrolytes.
Sr 2 Ni0.75Mn0.25Mo0 6 is a good anode material for IT-SOFCs.
the Sr 2 NiMoO 6 ceramic sample is stable in contact with the investigated oxygen-ionic electrolyte materials, while it is unstable with protonic electrolytes.
